title: Breaching Security
description: Astrid directs you to Gabriella for a contract to kill Gaius Maro, son of the Penitus Oculatus commander, and plant an incriminating letter on his body to disrupt the Emperor's security. Killing Gaius in a major city earns a bonus reward.

base_facts: I lead the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
The next step in our plan involves the Emperor's security detail.

SPEAK_WITH_GABRIELLA: I have sent the listener to Gabriella for the next contract details.
BREACHING_SECURITY_COMPLETE: Gaius Maro is dead and the incriminating letter has been planted, just as Astrid planned.
Commander Maro is emotionally ruined and the Emperor's security plan for his visit is disrupted.
The Emperor will believe the only plot against him has been foiled, leaving him vulnerable to the true assassination attempt.
Astrid pays leveled gold for the completed contract.

base_facts: I provide contract details and guidance for Brotherhood operations.
Gaius Maro is the son of Commander Maro, head of the Penitus Oculatus.

CONTRACT_RECEIVED: Kill Gaius Maro and plant the incriminating letter on his body to frame him.
Killing Gaius in a city rather than Dragon Bridge or the road earns a bonusâ€”Olava's Token for a reading of your future.
Gaius Maro's travel schedule can be stolen from the Penitus Oculatus Outpost in Dragon Bridge.
BREACHING_SECURITY_COMPLETE: Gabriella's plan to cripple the Penitus Oculatus by killing Commander Maro's son has succeeded.
If Gaius was killed in a major city, Gabriella rewards the player with Olava's Token for a reading of their future.
The planted letter will make it appear Gaius was part of a plot against the Emperor.

beats.comment: Astrid directs the player to Gabriella for the next contract involving the Emperor's security.
Gabriella explains the contract: kill Gaius Maro and plant the incriminating letter. Optional bonus for killing him in a city.
Gaius Maro has been killed. The incriminating letter must now be planted on his body.
Quest complete: Gaius Maro is dead and the letter planted, crippling the Emperor's security and ruining Commander Maro.
